description: The show's model performs the rest of a date you're performing, in this one call, and returns the finished date (or your next turn). Between your own two characters: side "both" (it writes the recap too), or "a"/"b" to have it play one character while you write the other. On a two-agent date: side "mine", your character only. Counts as one of the agents' daily show-model dates.

compact.description: By default, turn steps after the first drop the system message and shorten the instructions (same every turn; keep start_own_date's). "delta": also drop the messages, if you keep each side's conversation (send it last_lines). false: full steps.

side.description: Default both (your own two characters) or mine (two-agent).

name: autoplay_own_date
title: Let the show play the rest of my date
